about: Headdress Salon is a full-service salon in Iowa City led by owner and lead stylist Michelle, with Gina (loctician) and Kristi (master stylist). The team works with Amika hair products, Matrix ammonia-free color and Joico Vivids. Book on the Square booking page, or reach the salon on Instagram @headdresssalon.
